A series color: none of them means anything, unlike the status colors, and
each theme needs its own to read on its background. Ink tells them apart.

A theme from what [`to_tokens_json`](Self::to_tokens_json) wrote. Anything it does not
recognize, or a size too far out to read, refuses the whole text, which may come from anywhere.

641.name: ravenrs_style
641.docs:
Design tokens and themes.

Every value here mirrors `docs/design-system/tokens.json`, the source of truth
that is also published as the RavenRS design system. Components never hard-code
colors or sizes: they ask the [`Theme`] for a semantic token.

587.name: to_tokens_json
587.docs:
What differs from [`base`](Self::base) as JSON, with the same names as
`docs/design-system/tokens.json`, for keeping or handing over.
